notes.title: The Server update
notes.content:
[h1][b]Civilio 1.2 Changelog:[/b][/h1]
 Finally you can play with [b]up to 50 players[/b] in one server!
[list]
[*] You now have 3 save slots
[*] Added servers open to everyone
[*] 	Play with people all around the globe
[*] 	Build your bases with or against other people
[*] Added new skins
[*] Large optimizations
[*] You can now lock factions, so no other players can join
[*] Updated visuals on a couple of buildings
[*] Several minor and major bug fixes
[*] Removed Vilmos
[/list]
After 9 [strike]years[/strike] days in development, hopefully, it has been worth the wait
